title: Walk SE, 3D-first locked pipeline, round 3: lines + shading
question: Owner (Amendment 2): the biggest gap is lines and shading. Can cel shading, occlusion shadows, hair clumps and sel-out form lines, all derived from the 3D model, clean up walk SE while keeping every lock gate and determinism?
method: pipe/build_walk_se.sh (deterministic). New shade_lines.py: N.L bands from the camera normals with one upper-left key light, smoothed per material; clean cel shapes (opening/closing, minimum shape size); highlights only as lit-side rims (red e, obi Q top sheen); occlusion shadows (bangs, chin/neck, far jaw rim, thighs under the hem, under the obi, between the legs); hair highlight ring and clump seams, and skirt folds at the rig's panel seams, all attached to the rest position; sel-out interior lines (dark tone of the material on lit cells, K on shadow cells, outer silhouette K); new form lines: collar V and obi edge. Temporal: band hysteresis and N.L averaging along the surface-point flow, plus a temporal median on fill colours. One Opus line/shading critique (4/10), with its fixes applied.
result: All gates PASS: zigzags <= 1, L-corners 0, gaps 0, clumps 0, stray interior K 0, 13-14 colours (e and Q now used), 0 cross-material px, limbs 8/8, posture and GIF ok. Shading flips per surface point over 8 frames: 143 (317 before the temporal median; the round-2 2-tone build had 103). pxeval shade_swap .041 (round 2 .009), boil .025. Opus (on the first round-3 pass): 4/10; its fixes are applied, with no second critique.
verdict: Clearly more form: hair clumps and highlight band, collar V and obi edges, fold seams, cast shadows, and the sleeve separating from the body. Shading changes more between frames than the flat 2-tone build. Still needs owner review of the look at 1x.
